notes.title: Kobey's Flea Market is in town!
notes.content:
Now introducing the hats update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YrIVapo.gif[/img]

What comes in this update?

- added total HP bars. Now you have a better idea how much of a lead or deficit youre in.
- added Expiration dates on packs. As much as I'd like for the packs to last forever, at some point, we have to make room for new ones 🤷‍♀️
- Added a new Pack, Kobey's Flea Market in which you can not collect over 100 different hats!

Per usual, please report any bugs or feature requests!
